title: Omega Speedmaster Professional Moonwatch - calibre 321, exploded

subject.summary: An exploded 42 mm Omega Speedmaster Professional 'Moonwatch': steel case with twisted lugs and tachymeter bezel, triple-register dial with its chronograph hands, and the calibre 321 column-wheel movement beneath, its balance wheel oscillating. Layer outlines are measured from reference photographs; the key sizes come from Omega's published specifications.
